name: Zuul
sum: Zuul is an ankylosaurine from the Campanian Judith River Formation of Montana, known from a complete skull and tail with skin and keratin preserved.
holotype: A complete skull and tail club with in situ osteoderms, keratin and skin remains — Judith River Formation near Havre, Montana.
material: Holotype only, the most complete ankylosaurid known from North America.
exceptional: Osteoderms preserved in place with keratin and skin remains.
biology: Skull about 50 cm long with a tooth row of about 16 cm; the tail club was complete.
author: Arbour and Evans 2017
